minimal.title: Minimal kernel
minimal.desc: minimal is a built-in kernel shipped with the shell (standalone CLI + its own session files + SSE streaming). It cannot be installed or upgraded, and is not loaded by default — enable it with MHD_ENABLE_KERNELS=minimal.
